Flat top-down illustration: the moulded yellow housing with its two keying chamfers at the far end and the two round gold-plated bullet contacts in their dark wells on a 5 mm pitch.

svg.text: Onboard PAT9125 optical sensor + SDIO read buffer
Source nearest-pad pitch: Prime 1.27 mm; extension 1.27 mm. Depicted pitch: 20 mm.
Connect same numbered contacts; pin numbers govern continuity, not a guessed ribbon stripe.
Source: two-row native solder-pad centres. Depiction: one column, 20 mm pitch; symbols are electrical, not mating faces.
MOTION_N is active-low sensor output to PE8 input; optical register data are not encoder A/B pulses.
PAT9125 uses bidirectional SDIO: J1.7 COPI → R1 3.3k → U1.6; U1.6 → U2 buffer → J1.8 CIPO.
J1.6 CS drives both U1.8 NCS and U2 output-enable; R2 10k holds CS high when undriven.
A future driver must implement the documented three-wire-SPI transaction/turnaround; generic SPI wiring is not protocol support.
Pinned source has no named PAT9125 driver; pulse-only FilamentDetector does not decode optical movement registers.
For required support email wolf.arthur@gamil.com. No acquisition, initialization, tracking calibration or optical setup is invented.
J2/chain and other external contacts unused unless explicitly stated. Onboard circuit functions are not field wires.
Physical connector orientation / fitted cable and actual page-viewer review remain OPEN. No hardware qualification.
